u-s-steel.name: U.S. Steel
u-s-steel.description: United States Steel Corporation is a Japanese-owned American steel company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It produces and sells steel products including flat-rolled and tubular products for various industries. In 2025, it was acquired by Nippon Steel in a deal arranged with the US government.

u-s-bancorp.name: U.S. Bancorp
u-s-bancorp.description: U.S. Bancorp is an American multinational banking institution headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, and incorporated in Delaware. It is the parent company of U.S. Bank National Association and provides banking, investment, mortgage, trust, and payment services.

united-parks-resorts.name: United Parks & Resorts
united-parks-resorts.description: United Parks & Resorts Inc. is an American entertainment company headquartered in Orlando, Florida. It owns and operates 12 recreational destinations including eight theme parks and four water parks, with notable brands such as SeaWorld and Busch Gardens.

united-rentals.name: United Rentals
united-rentals.description: United Rentals, Inc. is an American equipment rental company operating in North America, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. It owns the largest rental fleet globally and operates 1,625 locations, including 1,504 in North America.

uniper.name: Uniper
uniper.description: Uniper SE is a German multinational energy company based in Düsseldorf, formed in 2016 by separating E.ON's fossil fuel assets. It is one of Europe's largest energy companies by revenue and has been state-owned since late 2022. The company employed about 6,800 people in over 40 countries as of 2019.

uztelecom.name: Uztelecom
uztelecom.description: Uztelecom is a telecommunications operator in Uzbekistan providing mobile communications, broadband Internet, fixed-line and IP telephony, digital television, and other services. It also develops cloud technologies, video surveillance, OTT services, data centers, and cybersecurity solutions.

usa-today-co.name: USA Today Co.
usa-today-co.description: USA Today Co., Inc., formerly known as Gannett, is an American mass media holding company headquartered in New York City. It is the largest U.S. newspaper publisher by total daily circulation.

ulker.name: Ülker
ulker.description: Ülker is a Turkish multinational food and beverage manufacturer based in Istanbul. Its products, including biscuits, cookies, crackers, and chocolates, are exported to 110 countries. The company has expanded its product categories beyond its core offerings.

universal-music-group.name: Universal Music Group
universal-music-group.description: Universal Music Group N.V. is a Dutch-American multinational music corporation with corporate headquarters in Hilversum, Netherlands, and operational headquarters in Santa Monica, California. It is one of the "Big Three" record labels globally and went public on the Euronext Amsterdam stock exchange in 2021.

u-s-cellular.name: U.S. Cellular
u-s-cellular.description: U.S. Cellular, formerly known as Array Digital Infrastructure, is an American wireless communications infrastructure manager and former mobile network operator. Founded in 1983, it is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, and was the fifth largest wireless carrier in the United States.

ultimate-software.name: Ultimate Software
ultimate-software.description: Ultimate Software was an American multinational technology company headquartered in Weston, Florida. Founded in 1990, it developed UltiPro, a cloud-based human capital management software, and was acquired by Hellman & Friedman Capital Partners in 2019.

uipath.name: UiPath
uipath.description: UiPath Inc. is a Romanian-American multinational software company that develops AI and automation software. Its products enable building and orchestrating AI agents to automate complex workflows.

unibail-rodamco-westfield.name: Unibail Rodamco Westfield
unibail-rodamco-westfield.description: Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield SE is a multinational commercial real estate company headquartered in Paris, France. It owns, develops, and operates large shopping centres in Europe and the United States, mostly under the Westfield brand, along with office buildings and convention centers in the Paris region.

unity-technologies.name: Unity Technologies
unity-technologies.description: Unity Software Inc. is an American video game software development company based in San Francisco. Founded in Denmark in 2004, it is known for developing Unity, a licensed game engine used to create video games and other applications.

ubiquiti.name: Ubiquiti
ubiquiti.description: Ubiquiti Inc. is an American technology company founded in San Jose, California, now based in New York City. It manufactures and sells wireless and wired data communication products for enterprises and homes under multiple brand names.

ugreen.name: Ugreen
ugreen.description: Ugreen is a Chinese consumer electronics brand owned by Ugreen Group Ltd and based in Shenzhen, Guangdong. Established in 2012, it specializes in USB hardware and other consumer electronics, launching network-attached storage devices in 2024.

urban-one.name: Urban One
urban-one.description: Urban One, Inc. is an American media conglomerate based in Silver Spring, Maryland. Founded in 1980 by Cathy Hughes, it primarily operates media properties targeting African American audiences.

uro-akovic.name: Đuro Đaković
uro-akovic.description: Đuro Đaković Grupa d.d. is a Croatian mechanical engineering company based in Slavonski Brod. Named after a prominent Yugoslav metal worker, it is one of Croatia's largest defence contractors and manufacturers.

upwork.name: Upwork
upwork.description: Upwork Inc. is an American freelancing platform headquartered in Palo Alto and San Francisco, California. Formed in 2013 by merging Elance Inc. and oDesk Corp, it was rebranded as Upwork in 2015 and went public in 2018. The company faced protests over fee changes and underwent workforce reductions in 2024 and 2026.

united-technologies-corporation.name: United Technologies Corporation
united-technologies-corporation.description: United Technologies Corporation was an American multinational conglomerate based in Farmington, Connecticut. It developed products in aircraft engines, aerospace systems, HVAC, elevators, fire and security, and industrial products. In 2020, it merged with Raytheon Company to form Raytheon Technologies.

utair-aviation.name: UTair Aviation
utair-aviation.description: Utair is a Russian airline headquartered at Khanty-Mansiysk Airport with hubs at Surgut and Vnukovo airports. It operates domestic and some international passenger services, helicopter services, and charter flights supporting the oil and gas industry in western Siberia. It is banned from flying in the EU.

userjoy-technology.name: UserJoy Technology
userjoy-technology.description: UserJoy Technology Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese video game development and publishing company founded in 1995 in Taipei. It publishes video games worldwide.

united-wholesale-mortgage.name: United Wholesale Mortgage
united-wholesale-mortgage.description: United Wholesale Mortgage (UWM) is an American wholesale mortgage lender headquartered in Pontiac, Michigan. Formerly United Shore Financial Services, it underwrites loans for independent brokers and is the largest mortgage lender in the United States as of 2024.

united-aircraft-corporation.name: United Aircraft Corporation
united-aircraft-corporation.description: PJSC United Aircraft Corporation is a Russian aerospace and defense corporation headquartered in Moscow. It consolidates Russian private and state-owned aircraft manufacturing companies engaged in the manufacture, design, and sale of military, civilian, transport, and unmanned aircraft. The Russian government holds a majority stake.

usa-rare-earth.name: USA Rare Earth
usa-rare-earth.description: USA Rare Earth, Inc. is an American mining and manufacturing company headquartered in Stillwater, Oklahoma. It specializes in extraction, processing, and production of rare-earth elements and permanent magnets, aiming to develop a domestic supply chain.

unum.name: Unum
unum.description: Unum Group is an American insurance company headquartered in Chattanooga, Tennessee. Founded in 1848, it was created by the 1999 merger of Unum Corporation and The Provident Companies. The company operates four businesses across the US, UK, Poland, and Colonial Life.

uponor.name: Uponor
uponor.description: Uponor Oyj is a Finnish company headquartered in Helsinki that sells products for drinking water delivery, radiant heating, and cooling. It employs approximately 3,700 people.

usiminas.name: Usiminas
usiminas.description: Usiminas is one of the largest steel producers in the Americas, with major steel mills located in Brazil. The company accounts for 28% of Brazil's total steel output. It has a total steel production capacity of 9.5 million metric tons per year.

ultrapar.name: Ultrapar
ultrapar.description: The Ultra Group is a Brazilian conglomerate operating in energy and logistics infrastructure through subsidiaries Ipiranga, Ultragaz, and Ultracargo. These subsidiaries are fully controlled by the holding company Ultrapar. Its shares are traded on the São Paulo and New York stock exchanges.

union-bank-of-taiwan.name: Union Bank of Taiwan
union-bank-of-taiwan.description: Union Bank of Taiwan is a bank headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan. It employs over 3,600 people.

us-foods.name: US Foods
us-foods.description: US Foods Holding Corp. is an American food service distributor supplying 250,000 locations including independent and chain restaurants, healthcare, hospitality, and educational institutions. It is the second-largest food service distributor in the United States after Sysco.

united-bank.name: United Bank
united-bank.description: United Bankshares, Inc. is a bank holding company dual-headquartered in Charleston, West Virginia and Fairfax, Virginia. It operates United Bank with nearly 250 offices across eight states and owns subsidiaries including George Mason Mortgage and United Brokerage.

united-security-bancshares.name: United Security Bancshares
united-security-bancshares.description: United Security Bancshares is a bank holding company based in Fresno, California, operating eleven branches. In 2026, it merged with Community West Bancshares, with Community West Bank as the surviving entity.

united-tractors.name: United Tractors
united-tractors.description: PT United Tractors Tbk is an Indonesian company and subsidiary of PT Astra International Tbk. It operates in six business lines including construction machinery, mining, and energy, with numerous branch offices and service points.

united-spirits-limited.name: United Spirits Limited
united-spirits-limited.description: United Spirits Limited (USL) is an Indian alcoholic beverages company headquartered at UB Tower in Bengaluru, Karnataka. It is the world's second-largest spirits company by volume and a subsidiary of Diageo, exporting products to over 37 countries.

ufp-technologies.name: UFP Technologies
ufp-technologies.description: UFP Technologies, Inc. is an American multinational company that develops and manufactures custom solutions for medical devices, sterile packaging, and other highly engineered products. It operates in the healthcare and pharmaceutical sector.

u-s-concrete.name: U.S. Concrete
u-s-concrete.description: U.S. Concrete, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Euless, Texas, specializing in concrete and heavy construction aggregates. Its main products include ready-mix concrete and aggregates, serving customers across multiple U.S. states and territories.

uzbekneftegaz.name: Uzbekneftegaz
uzbekneftegaz.description: Uzbekneftegaz is a state-owned holding company of Uzbekistan's oil and gas industry. It serves as the national holding company for the country's petroleum sector. The company is based in Uzbekistan.

umios.name: Umios
umios.description: Umios Corporation is a Japanese seafood company founded in 1880 in Osaka. It is the largest seafood company in Japan with main competitors including Nippon Suisan Kaisha and Kyokuyo Co., Ltd.

unipar-carbocloro.name: Unipar Carbocloro
unipar-carbocloro.description: Unipar Carbocloro is a publicly traded Brazilian chemical company based in São Paulo. The company is chaired by Frank Geyer Abubakir and operates in the chemical industry.

unipro.name: Unipro
unipro.description: Unipro is a Russian power generation company formed by merging five generation companies. The majority ownership (83.73%) is held by German energy company Uniper, with the remainder owned by minority shareholders. The company has had several general directors since 2023.

united-plantations.name: United Plantations
united-plantations.description: United Plantations Berhad is a Malaysia-based company specializing in oil palm plantations.

united-overseas-bank.name: United Overseas Bank
united-overseas-bank.description: United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a Singaporean regional bank headquartered at Raffles Place, Singapore. It has branches mainly in Southeast Asia and is one of the three major local banks in Singapore.

uzauto-motors.name: UzAuto Motors
uzauto-motors.description: UzAuto Motors is an automotive manufacturer owned by the Government of Uzbekistan and based in Asaka. It manufactures vehicles under the Chevrolet brand and formerly under the Ravon marque.

ukrnafta.name: Ukrnafta
ukrnafta.description: PJSC Ukrnafta is the largest Ukrainian company involved in oil and natural gas extraction. It also operates a nationwide network of gas filling stations in Ukraine.

u-blox.name: U-blox
u-blox.description: u-blox is a Swiss company that designs wireless semiconductors and modules for consumer, automotive, and industrial markets. Founded in 1997 as a spin-off from ETH Zurich, it operates as a fabless IC and design house.

united-online.name: United Online
united-online.description: United Online, Inc. is a company formed by the 2001 merger of NetZero and Juno Online Services. It is headquartered in Woodland Hills, California, and has evolved from providing dial-up Internet access to offering a range of products aided by acquisitions such as Classmates Online and MyPoints.

usana-health-sciences.name: USANA Health Sciences
usana-health-sciences.description: Usana Health Sciences, Inc. is an American multi-level marketing company based in Salt Lake City, Utah. It manufactures nutritional products, dietary supplements, and skincare products sold in 24 countries through independent distributors.

umh-properties.name: UMH Properties
umh-properties.description: UMH Properties, Inc. is a public equity real estate investment trust owning and operating 135 manufactured home communities with about 25,700 developed homesites. These communities are spread across 12 U.S. states. UMH also operates two communities in Florida through a joint venture with Nuveen Real Estate.

ube-corporation.name: UBE Corporation
ube-corporation.description: UBE Corporation is a Japanese chemical company that manufactures chemicals, plastics, battery materials, pharmaceuticals, cement, construction materials, and machinery. It is based in Japan and operates in multiple chemical-related industries.

udr.name: UDR
udr.description: UDR Inc. is a publicly traded real estate investment trust organized in Maryland with headquarters in Highlands Ranch, Colorado. It invests in apartments and owns interests in numerous apartment communities across 21 U.S. markets.

ugi-corporation.name: UGI Corporation
ugi-corporation.description: UGI Corporation is a natural gas and electric power distribution company headquartered in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania. It has extensive operations in the United States and Europe. The company operates in the energy industry.

universal-entertainment.name: Universal Entertainment
universal-entertainment.description: Universal Entertainment Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of pachinko, slot machines, arcade games, and other gaming products, as well as a video game publisher. Headquartered in Tokyo, it holds licenses to manufacture and distribute casino machines in Nevada, Mississippi, and New Jersey. The company was formerly known as Aruze Corporation.

universal-display-corporation.name: Universal Display Corporation
universal-display-corporation.description: Universal Display Corporation is a United States-based developer and manufacturer of organic light emitting diode (OLED) technologies and materials. It provides services to the display and lighting industries. The company operates within the computer hardware industry.

urban-outfitters.name: Urban Outfitters
urban-outfitters.description: Urban Outfitters, Inc. is a multinational lifestyle retail corporation headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. It operates in multiple countries including the US, UK, Canada, and others. The brand targets young adults with fashion apparel, accessories, and music products.

unieuro.name: Unieuro
unieuro.description: Unieuro S.p.A. is the largest Italian retailer of consumer electronics and household appliances by number of outlets. It operates a network of 460 stores throughout Italy.

ujjivan-small-finance-bank.name: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank
ujjivan-small-finance-bank.description: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Limited is a banking institution based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. It evolved from Ujjivan Financial Services, a microfinance company started in 2005, and became a small finance bank in 2017. In 2024, it merged with its predecessor under a reverse-merger scheme.

uralsib.name: Uralsib
uralsib.description: Uralsib is a Russian commercial bank headquartered in Moscow. As of 2022, it was one of Russia's largest banks by net asset value. The bank operates in the financial services sector.

united-utilities.name: United Utilities
united-utilities.description: United Utilities Group plc is the largest listed water company in the United Kingdom. Founded in 1995 from a merger, it manages the regulated water and wastewater network in North West England, serving over seven million people. Its service area includes Cumbria, Greater Manchester, Lancashire, Merseyside, Cheshire, and parts of Derbyshire.

unisys.name: Unisys
unisys.description: Unisys Corporation is an American technology company founded in 1986 and based in Blue Bell, Pennsylvania. It provides cloud, artificial intelligence, digital workplace, logistics, and enterprise computing services. The company operates in the information and communications technology sector.

urstadt-biddle-properties.name: Urstadt Biddle Properties
urstadt-biddle-properties.description: Urstadt Biddle Properties, Inc. was a real estate investment trust based in Greenwich, Connecticut. It primarily invested in shopping centers across New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut. The company merged with Regency Centers Corp in August 2023.

uaz.name: UAZ
uaz.description: UAZ, or Ulyanovsky Avtomobilny Zavod, is an automobile manufacturer based in Ulyanovsk, Russia. It produces off-road vehicles, buses, and trucks and has been part of the Sollers automotive group since 2000.

univar-solutions.name: Univar Solutions
univar-solutions.description: Univar Solutions Inc. is a global chemical and ingredients distributor based in the United States. The company also provides value-added services.

u-s-century-bank.name: U.S. Century Bank
u-s-century-bank.description: U.S. Century Bank is a community bank headquartered in Doral, Miami-Dade County, Florida. It operates as a Minority Depository Institution with a branch network in Miami-Dade and Broward counties. The bank is a member of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.

ubc-media-group.name: UBC Media Group
ubc-media-group.description: UBC Media Group was a production and content creation company that began as the Unique Broadcasting Company in 1989. In June 2014, it merged with 7digital to form 7digital Group Plc, a global digital music and radio platform.

ubm-information-ltd.name: UBM Information Ltd.
ubm-information-ltd.description: UBM plc was a British business-to-business events organizer headquartered in London, England. It operated in live media, communications, marketing services, and data provision, serving various industries. UBM was listed on the London Stock Exchange before its acquisition by Informa in 2018.

uil-holdings-corporation.name: UIL Holdings Corporation
uil-holdings-corporation.description: UIL Holdings Corporation was a diversified energy delivery company serving electric and natural gas utility customers in 66 communities across two states. It merged with Iberdrola USA in 2015 to form Avangrid.

umb-financial-corporation.name: UMB Financial Corporation
umb-financial-corporation.description: UMB Financial Corporation is an American financial services company headquartered in Kansas City, Missouri. It offers deposit solutions, credit services, investing, and wealth management to individuals, companies, and institutions in the U.S. and Ireland.

utstarcom.name: UTStarcom
utstarcom.description: UTStarcom Holdings Corp. is a Chinese global telecom infrastructure provider headquartered in Beijing. It supplies telecommunication devices to fixed and mobile network operators and enterprises, with markets in China, Japan, India, Africa, Central and Latin America, and the Middle East.

ulta-beauty.name: Ulta Beauty
ulta-beauty.description: Ulta Beauty, Inc. is an American chain of cosmetic stores headquartered in Bolingbrook, Illinois. It offers a wide range of cosmetics, fragrances, nail, bath and body products, beauty tools, and haircare products, with nearly every store featuring a full-service salon.

ultratech-cement.name: UltraTech Cement
ultratech-cement.description: UltraTech Cement Limited is an Indian multinational cement company based in Mumbai. It is the largest manufacturer of grey cement, ready-mix concrete, and white cement in India and ranks fifth largest worldwide.

ultrasis.name: Ultrasis
ultrasis.description: Ultrasis Group Plc was a UK-based healthcare company that developed computerized healthcare products based on Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT). The company was dissolved in 2017.

unifirst.name: UniFirst
unifirst.description: UniFirst Corporation is an American uniform rental company based in Wilmington, Massachusetts. It manufactures, sells, and rents uniforms and protective clothing, operating over 260 facilities across the US, Canada, and Europe.

unify-corporation.name: Unify Corporation
unify-corporation.description: Unify Corporation, originally known as Daegis Inc., is a software company founded in 1980 and headquartered in Irving, Texas. It developed database management systems and 4th-generation programming language tools for Unix and later released a cross-platform development tool called VISION supporting Windows, Linux, and Unix.

united-community-bank.name: United Community Bank
united-community-bank.description: United Community is an American bank headquartered in South Carolina and one of the largest full-service financial institutions in the Southeast. It operates 200 offices across six states and is the largest bank headquartered in South Carolina by total asset size.

united-natural-foods.name: United Natural Foods
united-natural-foods.description: United Natural Foods, Inc. (UNFI) is a natural and organic food wholesale distributor based in Providence, Rhode Island. It is the largest publicly traded distributor of health and specialty food in the U.S. and Canada and is a main supplier to Whole Foods Market.

unitika.name: Unitika
unitika.description: Unitika Ltd is a Japanese company based in Osaka that produces textiles, glass, plastics, and carbon fiber products. It is also known for films used in consumer products such as athletic apparel and food packaging.

universal-forest-products.name: Universal Forest Products
universal-forest-products.description: UFP Industries, Inc. is a holding company headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan, serving retail, industrial, and construction markets. It operates 218 affiliated operations supplying tens of thousands of products across its retail, construction, and packaging segments.

upstart-holdings.name: Upstart Holdings
upstart-holdings.description: Upstart is a lending platform based in San Mateo, California, launched in 2012. Initially offering Income Share Agreements, it pivoted in 2014 to personal loan products including traditional 3-year and 5-year loans.

urthecast.name: UrtheCast
urthecast.description: Urthecast was a Canadian company specializing in satellite imaging, data services, and geo-analytics. It operated cameras on the International Space Station and satellites in low Earth orbit. The company filed for creditor protection in 2020 and led to the creation of EarthDaily Analytics in 2021.

utz-brands.name: Utz Brands
utz-brands.description: Utz Brands, Inc. is an American snack food company based in Hanover, Pennsylvania. It produces a variety of snacks including potato chips and pretzels, and supplies snacks to warehouse clubs and merchandisers.

uralkali.name: Uralkali
uralkali.description: Uralkali is a Russian producer and exporter of potash fertilizer. The company operates five mines and seven ore-treatment mills located in Berezniki and Solikamsk. Uralkali employs about 12,000 people and is traded on the Moscow Exchange.

united-wagon-company.name: United Wagon Company
united-wagon-company.description: United Wagon Company is a major Russian manufacturer of railway freight cars headquartered in Moscow. The company operates in the mechanical engineering industry and is based in Russia.

unitel.name: Unitel
unitel.description: Unitel S.A. is a private Angolan mobile phone company established on 8 March 2001 as a joint-stock company. It is owned by the Angolan state after being nationalised in 2022. The company operates in the telecommunications industry in Angola.

unite-students.name: Unite Students
unite-students.description: The Unite Group Plc is a British developer, owner, and operator of purpose-built student accommodation. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. The company operates in the United Kingdom.

union-bank-of-israel-ltd.name: Union Bank Of Israel Ltd.
union-bank-of-israel-ltd.description: The Union Bank of Israel, Ltd., also known as Bank Igud, was the seventh largest Israeli bank with thirty branches across the country. It operates in the banking sector in Israel.

unisoc.name: UNISOC
unisoc.description: UNISOC (Shanghai) Technologies Co., Ltd. is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Shanghai. It designs semiconductor products for smartphones, IoT devices, automotive electronics, and other connected devices. UNISOC is part of Tsinghua Unigroup.

union-gas.name: Union Gas
union-gas.description: Union Gas Limited was a major Canadian natural gas company based in Ontario. It serviced about 1.5 million customers in various regions of Ontario and has been a subsidiary of Enbridge since 2017 following a merger with Spectra Energy.

umma-bank.name: Umma Bank
umma-bank.description: Umma Bank was established on 14 April 1907 under an agreement between Italy and the Turkish Sultan. It was renamed Umma Bank in 1911 following a revolutionary decision to give commercial banks Arabic names. It is one of Libya's historic banks.

ulendo-airlink.name: Ulendo Airlink
ulendo-airlink.description: Nyasa Express Limited, trading as FlyNyasa, is a Malawian charter airline operating from Kamuzu International Airport in Lilongwe. It began operations in 2011 under the name Ulendo Airlink and rebranded in February 2022.

urban96-radio-network.name: Urban96 Radio Network
urban96-radio-network.description: Urban 96 Radio Network is a commercial English-speaking radio station based in Lekki, Lagos, Nigeria. It broadcasts an urban contemporary format including R&B, hip hop, and pop music. The station is owned by Alphavision Multimedia, a subsidiary of CMA Group.

union-bank-of-nigeria.name: Union Bank of Nigeria
union-bank-of-nigeria.description: Union Bank of Nigeria Plc is a commercial bank headquartered in Marina, Lagos Island, Nigeria. It has been operating in Nigeria since 1917.

ughelli-power-plant.name: Ughelli Power Plant
ughelli-power-plant.description: Transcorp Power Plc operates the Ughelli Power Plant, a gas-fired thermal plant in Delta State, Nigeria. Founded in 2012 as Transcorp Ughelli Power Limited, it is the largest fossil-fuel based power station in Nigeria.

uganda-securities-exchange.name: Uganda Securities Exchange
uganda-securities-exchange.description: The Uganda Securities Exchange (USE) is the principal stock exchange of Uganda, founded in June 1997. It operates under the jurisdiction of Uganda's Capital Markets Authority, which reports to the Bank of Uganda, the country's central bank.

universo-online.name: Universo Online
universo-online.description: Universo Online is a Brazilian company providing web content, products, and services. It is part of the Grupo Folha enterprise. The company operates in the online service provider industry.

ultragaz.name: Ultragaz
ultragaz.description: Ultragaz is a Brazilian company that distributes liquefied petroleum gas (LPG). It originated from Empresa Brasileira de Gás a Domicílio, founded by Ernesto Igel, the founder of Ultra Group.

union-de-industrias-militares.name: Union de Industrias Militares
union-de-industrias-militares.description: The Unión de Industrias Militares is Cuba's state-owned military-industrial complex. It repairs weaponry and technology for the Cuban Revolutionary Armed Forces and produces light weapons, ammunition, and other equipment. It also serves other requirements of the Cuban economy.

union-carriage-wagon.name: Union Carriage & Wagon
union-carriage-wagon.description: Union Carriage & Wagon (UCW) is a South African rolling stock manufacturer. In 2016, after Alstom acquired a majority stake, the company was renamed Alstom Ubunye.

undurraga-winery.name: Undurraga Winery
undurraga-winery.description: Viña Undurraga is a Chilean producer of wines and sparkling wines located in Talagante, Maipo Valley near Santiago. Founded in 1885, it is one of the oldest wineries in Chile with vineyards across several valleys and exports most of its production.

underground-contenidos.name: Underground contenidos
underground-contenidos.description: Underground Producciones is a media producer in Argentina specializing in television and film production. The company was founded in 2006 by Sebastian Ortega and Pablo Culell.

uala.name: Ualá
uala.description: Ualá is an Argentine fintech company providing a mobile app for managing a Mastercard prepaid debit card and other financial services. Founded by Pierpaolo Barbieri, it competes with digital banks like Brubank. The company operates in the banking sector.

unitan.name: Unitán
unitan.description: Unitán is an Argentine company producing quebracho tannins. It sells 40,000 tonnes of tannins used in the tanning industry, drilling industry, enological applications, and as animal food. The company operates within Argentina.

unitel-bolivia.name: Unitel
unitel-bolivia.hq: Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia
unitel-bolivia.description: UNITEL is a Bolivian commercial television network headquartered in Santa Cruz de la Sierra, La Paz, and Cochabamba. Founded in 1997 from the association of several stations, it broadcasts sports, entertainment, political, and news programs nationwide. It is owned by businessman Osvaldo Monasterio Nieme.

uruguay-northern-railway.name: Uruguay Northern Railway
uruguay-northern-railway.description: The Uruguay Northern Railway was one of the five original rail systems in Uruguay. Registered in London in 1887, it was part of the early development of the country's rail infrastructure.

unibank.name: Unibank
unibank.description: Unibank, S.A. is one of Haiti's two largest private commercial banks. Founded in 1993 by Haitian investors, it is the main company of Groupe Financier National (GFN). The bank opened its first office in downtown Port-au-Prince and had 51 branches across Haiti by the end of 2017.

union-bancaire-pour-le-commerce-et-l-ind.name: Union bancaire pour le commerce et l'industrie
union-bancaire-pour-le-commerce-et-l-ind.legal_name: Union bancaire pour le commerce et l'industrie
union-bancaire-pour-le-commerce-et-l-ind.description: Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et l'Industrie is a bank based in Tunis, Tunisia, formed in 1961 by merging prior operations of Banque Nationale pour le Commerce et l'Industrie. It was controlled by BNP Paribas until 2021, when it was acquired by Tunisian insurer CARTE, controlled by the Doghri family.

unefon-icr.name: Unefón ICR
unefon-icr.description: AT&T Mexico, S.A.U. is a Mexican mobile telephone operator and subsidiary of AT&T. Headquartered in Mexico City, its network covers 90% of Mexico and serves 13% of the wireless market. It is the third-largest wireless carrier in Mexico.
